scenario: Discussing a news story with a colleague
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Mu kuri zindi, ishobora gutangwa igitangaza cyangwa igisubizo.
Ishimangane ryishimwa kugena kuri ikibazo cyangwa igikorwa.
Urwego rw'abanyamurenge bafitiye ububiko mu gihugu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you see the report about the new public transport plan?
dialogue.translation: Wabonye igisubizo kuri ubucuruzi bw'ibinyabiziga bya umumwe?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I read it. Although the government says it will help, many people are against it.
dialogue.translation: Yego, nariko. Ndetse ubucuruzi bw'ibinyabiziga bya umumwe buvuga ko buzaba bufasha, abantu benshi barimo kuri ubwenge.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think the main issue is the cost. It might increase taxes, and that could have a big effect on the economy.
dialogue.translation: Ntekereza ko ikibazo cy'ingenzi ni ububiko. Bishobora gutegura imiti, kandi ibyo bishobora gutanga ikiganiro kuri ubucuruzi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Probably, but they say it will create more jobs. I'm not sure what they will decide.
dialogue.translation: Ndetse, ariko bavuga ko buzaba bugaragaza ubukorikorane. Nta nkimenyetso mfite ko bazatangira.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but if they cut other services, it will be a problem. The public might be more affected than they think.
dialogue.translation: Yego, ariko niba bashyiramo ubukorikorane, buzaba ikibazo. Abantu bashobora kugirwa n'ubwenge kurushaho kubitekereza.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's wait and see. Although I'm a bit worried, I hope they make a good choice.
dialogue.translation: Tuyubake kandi tubone. Ndetse ntekereza neza, nshaka ko bazatangira neza.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, we can only hope. I'll check the news again tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: Yego, nshaka gusa. Nzagerageza kuri zindi by'umunsi wacyaha.

Bifashishwa kugena umutima ku buryo bwo kwishyura ibintu bitandukanye.
Bifashishwa kugena umutima ku buryo bwo kwishyura ibintu bitandukanye.
Bifashishwa kugena umutima ku buryo bwo kwishyura ibintu bitandukanye.
Bifashishwa kugena umutima ku buryo bwo kwishyura ibintu bitandukanye.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I don't agree with your plan to go to the beach, though.
dialogue.translation: Nta n’umwe wacu yishyura igikorwa cyawe cy’ikende ku mazi, nyamara.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe we could change the time instead of changing the place.
dialogue.translation: Byari kuva twari twagize igihe mu cyo kinyuma cyo kugena umutima ku buryo bwo kwishyura ibintu bitandukanye.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, but I'm not sure it's the best matter to discuss right now.
dialogue.translation: Ibyo ni ibyiza, ariko nta n’umwe wacu yishyura ko ari ibintu byiza kugena umutima ku buryo bwo kwishyura ibintu bitandukanye.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Perhaps we should just decide together without arguing.
dialogue.translation: Byari kuva twari twagize igikorwa mu buryo bwo kwishyura ibintu bitandukanye bihariye kugena umutima.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I agree, but I still think the plan has a problem, though.
dialogue.translation: Nishyura neza, ariko nta n’umwe wacu yishyura ko igikorwa cyacu cy’ibintu byiza, nyamara.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe we can try a different plan, perhaps a picnic instead?
dialogue.translation: Byari kuva twari twagize igikorwa cy’ibintu byiza, byari kuva twari twagize igikorwa mu cyo kinyuma cyo kugena umutima ku buryo bwo kwishyura ibintu bitandukanye?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure, that could work without any problem. Let's do that, though.
dialogue.translation: Yee, ibyo bitari byo kugena umutima ku buryo bwo kwishyura ibintu bitandukanye. Tugize ibyo, nyamara.

scenario: Giving feedback on someone's work
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Bishobora kugirwa gutangira ko ikintu si cyatumye kugeza ubu.
Bishobora gutangira amagambo yongeye. Ibitekerezo: 'though' ari mu mirimo ifite uburyo bwo kugirwa, ariko birangwa hasi kuba buri mu biherutse.
Bishobora gutangira uburyo bwo kugirwa ikintu.
Bishobora gutangira amagambo menshi cyangwa ibikorwa kugirango uburyo bwo kugirwa.
Gutanga ikintu kugirango uburyo bwo kugirwa.
Gutekereza ikintu mbere yo gutanga ikintu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I’ve read your draft, but I haven’t finished the last section yet.
dialogue.translation: Nafashe igitabo cyawe, ariko nta cyatumye kugeza ubu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That’s okay. The quality of the beginning is quite good, I think.
dialogue.translation: Ni byiza. Uburyo bwo kugirwa bwa kwinjira ni byiza, ntekereza.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I agree with that, though we need to improve the ending a lot.
dialogue.translation: Ndagiye n'ibyo, ariko dufite gutekereza uburyo bwo kugirwa bwa kwinjira.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, the result is not strong enough. However, your ideas are clear.
dialogue.translation: Yego, ingeso si byinshi. Ariko, ibitekerezo byawe ni bizana.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks. What else should I consider for the final version?
dialogue.translation: Urakaze. Ni iki cyubaka gutekereza kuri ivyamukuru?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It’s possible to add more examples, and provide more evidence for your claims.
dialogue.translation: Bishoboka gutanga amerekezo menshi, no gutekereza amabwiriza menshi kuri ibyo wibwira.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great, I’ll work on that. Can you support me with the data?
dialogue.translation: Ni byiza, nzagira ku byo. Ushobora gutanga ikintu cyatumye kugeza ubu?

key_phrases.translation: Ushobora gutanga ikintu cyatumye kugeza ubu...?

scenario: Explaining a problem to customer service
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I received my order yesterday, but the color is wrong.
dialogue.translation: Mwaramutse, narakwiye gushakisha janjye kurya, ariko icolor bihetse.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Could you send me a photo of the item you received?
dialogue.translation: Naba ntekanye kwumva ibyo. Wowe ushobora kuhereza foto y'ibintu warakwiye?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll send it right away. Also, I need to return the item and get a refund.
dialogue.translation: Yego, nzohereza byumva. Nanone, nashaka kurahira ibintu kandi ntangire.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. We will not charge you for the return. Please check your email for instructions.
dialogue.translation: Mu by'ingene. Nta gucura kugutangira. Ndagukire reba imeli yawe kuri amabwiriza.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. How long will I have to wait for the refund?
dialogue.translation: Murakoze. Ni ubuhe buryo nzokugera kugutangira?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Usually it takes 5–7 days. Please be careful with the return label we provide.
dialogue.translation: Hagati ya 5 na 7 munsi. Ndagukire mufite ubwoba kuri etiketi y'urupfu dutanga.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great, I'll be careful. Thank you for solving my problem.
dialogue.translation: Ni byiza, nzoba mufite ubwoba. Murakoze kwihuta ibibazo byanjye.

scenario: Talking about ambitions and career goals
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Bifashwa kuri indangagaciro cy'ishushanyo cyangwa igikorwa, kigambira cyane kurushaho 'get'.
Bifashwa kuri uburyo umuntu yakozwe mu gishushanyo, si ku 'carrera universitaria'.
Byagenze, ariko birashyizwe mu buryo bwo kugena umubare.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I want to achieve a high position in my career, but I know it will require a lot of effort.
dialogue.translation: Nshaka gushakisha ikibazo cy'ububasha mu gishushanyo cyanjye, ariko nzi ko bizagushaka ubushake bwinshi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a great goal. What kind of role would you like to reach in the future?
dialogue.translation: Ni igikorwa cyiza. Ni uburyo biri mu buryo ubwiza ubwiza gutegura mu gihe kirekire?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'd love to lead a team someday, but I think I need more experience first.
dialogue.translation: Nshaka kwiga igikorwa cy'ubutegetsi bwinshi, ariko ntekereza ko nshaka ubushake bwinshi mu ntango.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe you can find an opportunity to manage a small project at work.
dialogue.translation: Naho ubona ko ubona ikibazo cyo kwiga igikorwa cy'ubutegetsi bwinshi mu gishushanyo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I hope so. Success doesn't come overnight, so I'll continue studying and improving my skills.
dialogue.translation: Nshaka ko ari. Ububasha ntibutegura mu gihe kirekire, bityo nzagiye kwiyambara kwiga no kwiyongera ubushake bwanjye.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's the right attitude. I'm sure you'll achieve everything you set your mind to.
dialogue.translation: Ni uburyo bwiza. Nzi ko uzagushakisha byose ubishuje mu mutima.

scenario: Discussing health habits and lifestyle
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ibika byerekana uburyo ikoraniye kuri imyitozo.
Nako zibika birahereza umubiri, ariko hano byashyizwe nk'igikorwa.
Ubwoba bwa mubiri no wa mu bicumuro.
Ubwoba bwa mubiri cyangwa mu bicumuro.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I try to exercise in the morning, but I don't do it often.
dialogue.translation: Ntekereza kugenzura mu gitondo, ariko ntabwo ndibikora bikomeye.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's okay. The important thing is to listen to your body and find a routine that works for you.
dialogue.translation: Ni byiza. Ibintu by'ingenzi ni ukumva umubiri wawe no kugira umwanya wo kugenzura.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I know. I feel much better when I have more energy during the day.
dialogue.translation: Nzi. Ndikumva neza kurushaho igihe ndafite ingufu za kugenzura mu munsi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, and sleep is a key part of that. Do you sleep at least seven hours?
dialogue.translation: Yego, no kugira ubutunzi ni ipfosha ry'uburyo. Ese wogera umunsi wa so?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Usually, yes. But my main problem is stress, not sleep.
dialogue.translation: Ntabwo ndabikora, ariko ibintu byanjye ni ubwoba, si kugira ubutunzi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Stress can affect your health a lot. Maybe you need a new habit to relax, like reading or walking.
dialogue.translation: Ubwoba bukwiye kuba buri kintu kuri ubwoba bwawe. Byari byo kuba byinshi, wabikora ikibazo cy'ubwoba, nk'uko ugira cyangwa ukora.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, because I want to feel healthier overall.
dialogue.translation: Ni idea ni byiza, kubera ko ndashaka kuba ndikumva neza kurushaho.

scenario: Describing a recent trip in detail
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ikorwa kugirango ikorereho urugendo rwose, hasi no kwishyura cyangwa ubucuruzi.

Ikorwa kugirango ikorereho ibyo ubona mu kuri.
Bishoboka kuba bihagije cyangwa bigaragaza; muri iyi si icaragaragara.
No ari no nomero: 'travel' = kwimura mu buryo burambye.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How was your trip to the mountains last weekend?
dialogue.translation: Urugendo rwawe ku magana rwari urenzehe?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It was quite wonderful, but we arrived later than we expected because of the traffic.
dialogue.translation: Byari byiza cyane, ariko twagucura nyuma y'uko twari twiteye kubera umuyego.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you stay in a hotel or in a cabin?
dialogue.translation: Mwaririye mu hoteri cyangwa mu ishyamba?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We stayed in a small cabin with an amazing view of the lake.
dialogue.translation: Twagiriye mu ishyamba rishya rifite umwanya wa kirekire wa kinyaga.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Although the weather was cloudy, did you still enjoy the experience?
dialogue.translation: Naho ubusa butari bugeze neza, mwararemye ubumenyi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, we decided to go hiking, and we had a wonderful time, however, the trail was quite steep.
dialogue.translation: Yego, twagize gukorera, twari dufite igihe kirekire, nyamara, urugendo rwari ruri rishyushye.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'm glad you had such a good time. I love to travel to new places too.
dialogue.translation: Nshimiye ko mwararemyeye. Ndashaka kwimura mu magare yo hejuru n'ubundi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think plastic waste is a serious problem, but people still use too much of it.
dialogue.translation: Nibagira yuko ibyondo by'ibishi by'ibishi ni ibara, ariko abantu bigeze bashimisha ibintu byinshi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.yes: I know. A common mistake is using single plastic bags for everything.
dialogue.translation: Nibagira yuko. Ibara rikaze ni kugura ibyondo by'ibishi by'ibishi byo kugura ibintu byinshi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. That habit can cause a lot of damage to the environment over time.
dialogue.translation: Ndetse. Iyo mwanyururo igishobora gutuma ibintu byinshi muri ingabankirwa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, what is the best action we can take to reduce our impact?
dialogue.translation: Bityo, iki ni igikorwa gishyashya kandi gishobora gutuma ikintu gishobora gutuma ikintu gishobora gutuma ikintu?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, using a reusable bottle is a simple step. And it's likely to become a habit quickly.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That makes sense. I'm not against small changes, though. Every little bit helps.

scenario: Discussing a decision you had to make
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Mu mpapuro wa igituma, ibigirwa ubwoko bwo kumenya ibyiza no bibyi.
Ibigirwa ubushishozi cyangwa ikintu gikomeye ariko si ibyategetsweho neza.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I had to choose between two job offers last week.
dialogue.translation: Narateye kuri gutanga ibintu bibiri by'ishushanyo by'akazi kuri iyambere.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a tough decision. What options did you weigh?
dialogue.translation: Iyo ni igituma kinini. Ni iki cyo bongererwa wateye?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I considered the salary and the commute, but the risk of moving to a new city was a big factor.
dialogue.translation: Nateye ubushishozi n'ubwoko bw'ubushishozi, ariko ububiko bwo gutwara mu mugi mukuru bwateye ububiko.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Were you certain about the outcome of each option?
dialogue.translation: Wari ushishozi kuri inguvu z'icyo bongererwa?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Not fully, although I knew the salary was higher in the second job.
dialogue.translation: Ntibyari byose, nanka nari mubushishozi yuko ubushishozi bwari burimo mu kuri mu kuri.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, what did you finally decide?
dialogue.translation: Bityo, ni iki cyo wateye mu kuri?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I chose the first job, rather than the second, due to the shorter commute and better work-life balance.
dialogue.translation: Nateye akazi kuri iyambere, mu kuri kuri kuri, kubera ubwoko bw'ubushishozi n'ubwoko bw'ubushishozi bwiza.

scenario: Explaining why you changed your mind
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ikorwa n'ijambo 'mind' kugirango vise uruhare rw'iteraniro ry'ibiryumva.
Mu 'change your mind' bishobora kuvuga kuhindura igituma.
Ikorwa kugirango vise igihe wahinduye igituma.
Bishobora gukoreshwa mu buryo bwo kwemeza cyangwa bwo gutangira.
Bivuga ku buryo bwo kugenzura cyangwa igikorwa.
Ikorwa kugirango vise ibintu byari byaba biteye.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've changed my mind about the trip to the beach this weekend.
dialogue.translation: Narahinduye igituma ku jya ku kugenda ku magare aha k'umunsi w'umukorere.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Really? Why? You seemed so excited about it before.
dialogue.translation: Byukuri? Kubera iki? Mbere waremye kuba wihutiye neza.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, I realized that the weather forecast is bad, and actually, I have a lot of work to do.
dialogue.translation: Nuko, nabonye ko amakuru y'ijoro atari neza, kandi mu by'ukuri, nifite akazi menshi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But you had a plan to relax and enjoy the sun!
dialogue.translation: Ariko waragize kugenzura kugumana no kugumana neza n'ijoro!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but I realized that it's not possible to finish my project if I go. Since the deadline is Monday, I need to stay home.
dialogue.translation: Yego, ariko nabonye ko ntabishoboka kwishyura igikorwa cyanjye njogenda. Kubera ko umunsi w'ishyura ari wa mbere, nshaka kwica mu rugo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a fact. But you could work in the morning and go later, instead of canceling everything.
dialogue.translation: Ibyo ni ukuri. Ariko ubishoboka kugenzura mu gitondo no kugenda nyuma, mu cyo kigezo gukura byose.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, though I need to see if my friend can support me with the ride. Thanks for the advice!
dialogue.translation: Ibyo ni ibitekerezo byiza, ariko nshaka kubona yadi umugenzi wanjye ashobora kushyirirwa n'ijoro. Urakoze kuri gushyirira!

scenario: Talking about cultural differences
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Bishobora kuduha amakuru akenerwa kuri imico, ibitekerezo n'imishinho y'umuryango.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I find it interesting how many cultural differences there are between countries.
dialogue.translation: Nibwira ko ni cyane cyane kumenya ubwabuzi bwinshi bw'ubwoko bw'amajyepfo hagati y'amajyepfo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, even something like greeting can be a custom that changes the behavior of people.
dialogue.translation: Yego, byari byo kugira inguvu nk'igitsina cyo gutegura bishobora kuba umwirondoro wubaka ubushishozi bw'abantu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: For example, in my culture, it's rude to eat with your hands, but in some places it's completely polite.
dialogue.translation: Mu mwezi, mu rwego rwanjye, kuba ntirengagise kurya n'amaboko, ariko mu bihugu bimwe byose ni nyubwo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I usually expect people to follow local customs, but I try to respect different ones.
dialogue.translation: Nkenshi nkwemera abantu kugira ubwoba bw'imico y'igihugu, ariko nshaka kwishimira ibindi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's good. I think many customs are similar in essence, just expressed differently.
dialogue.translation: Ni byiza. Ntekereza ko imico yinshi irahuye mu buryo, nyamara irahishurwa mu buryo mwinshi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, the key is to be open and learn about the differences between us.
dialogue.translation: Bityo, ububiko ni kuba wifutiye no kwiga iby'ubwabuzi hagati yacu.

scenario: Discussing technology in daily life
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ikiboneko cyangwa ikoranabuhanga kigahe cyakoreshwa nka telefoni cyangwa taburete.
Gutanga amakuru mu matora ku gicurasi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need to connect my new phone to the Wi-Fi, but I can't find the settings.
dialogue.translation: Nshaka kugiranganira telefoni yanjye ya kera ku Wi-Fi, ariko ntabwo nashobora kubona ibikorwa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's simple. Just go to the settings app and look for the Wi-Fi option.
dialogue.translation: Nibyo bihanze. Tama mu porogaramu y'ibikorwa kandi reba ikintu cy' Wi-Fi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, I see. But I also want to download a new messenger app to message my friends.
dialogue.translation: Oho, mbona. Ariko nashaka kugura porogaramu ya kera y'umugambi kugira ngo ndatumire umugambi ku bwenyine.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's useful, but check the battery first. Downloading can use a lot of energy.
dialogue.translation: Nibyo bihanze, ariko reba gucungwa mbere. Kugura bishobora gutumiza amabara menshi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. And what about the screen? Sometimes it stays on too long.
dialogue.translation: Wowe ni ukuri. Kandi iki gihe ekura? Hashi igihe kinini cyane kirimo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You can change that in the settings, too. Also, as a user, you should share your location with friends only if you trust them.
dialogue.translation: Nakuwe, ushobora kubika ibyo mu bikorwa. No kandi, nk'umukoresha, ushaka gushyiraho aho uri na bwenyine gusa iyo ukabishije.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks! Now I feel more comfortable using my device online.
dialogue.translation: Murakoze! Ubu nifite ubwoba buri kandi nkorora ikoranabuhanga yanjye mu matora.

scenario: At a formal meeting giving your opinion
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Bifashishwa mu mico y'igishushanyo kugirango hishyurwe igitekerezo.
Mu mico y'igishushanyo, bishobora gutanga ubutaka cyangwa ikibazo kigoye kuri gutarurirwa.
Bifashishwa kugirango hishyurwe igisubizo cyangwa igitekerezo.
Bifashishwa kugirango hishyurwe igisubizo cyangwa igishushanyo mu buryo bw'igishushanyo.
Bifashishwa kugirango hishyurwe ko hari igitekerezo kirekire mbere y'igishushanyo.
Umubare w'amagambo ufite ubwoko bw'igishushanyo ufite ubwoko bw'igishushanyo.
Umubare w'amagambo ufite ubwoko bw'igishushanyo ufite ubwoko bw'igishushanyo.
Umubare w'amagambo ufite ubwoko bw'igishushanyo ufite ubwoko bw'igishushanyo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: In my view, the main issue is the budget for the project.
dialogue.translation: Ku bw'igitekerezo cyange, ikibazo kibanze ni ubucuruzi bw'ishushanyo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I see your point, however, I think we should consider the timeline first.
dialogue.translation: Nzimiye igitekerezo cyawe, nyamara, ntekereza ko dusige kwitekereza igihe cyabanze.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That is a valid point. Therefore, perhaps we can discuss both together.
dialogue.translation: Iyo ni igitekerezo gihuje. Kubera iyo, byari twobora ibiri byose hamwe.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I agree with that. In addition, we could ask for more data from the team.
dialogue.translation: Nta umenyi n'ubundi, twobashobora gutegura amakuru menshi ku mushobora.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good idea. According to the latest report, we have some flexibility.
dialogue.translation: Igitekerezo kiheje. Kuri urupapuro rw'umunsi, dushobora kugira ubushishozwe.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Then I suggest we prepare a proposal with both options.
dialogue.translation: Uretse ntekereza ko dusiga kwerekana igisubizo kifite ibintu byombi.

scenario: Describing a person's character in depth
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Bikoreshwa kugirango dukore umuntu uvuga ukuri.
Bikoreshwa kugirango dukore umuntu ukeneye ubwoba.
Umuntu umfite ubwoba n'ubwoba bwo kumenya abandi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I really admire my sister because she is always honest, even when it's difficult.
dialogue.translation: Nshaka cyane umwanzangu kubera yoba ari ukuri, n'ubwo ari ubwoba.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's great. My best friend is very brave – he once stood up to a bully at school.
dialogue.translation: Ni byiza. Umugenzi wanjye mwiza cyane – yaramaze yaba ari umukene mu gishushanyo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Wow, that takes courage. My sister is also generous and often helps our neighbors with their groceries.
dialogue.translation: Yee, igira ubwoba. Umwanzangu n'inyandikishwa no kuba bihagije ubufasha abaturage twe mu byokurya.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: She sounds kind. My friend is usually patient, but he can get into a bad mood if he's tired.
dialogue.translation: Yaba ari mwiza. Umugenzi wanjye yoba ari mfite ubwoba, ariko yoba ashobora kugira ubwoba bw'ubwoba n'ubwo ari umubiri.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see. My sister is a bit shy at first, but once you know her, she's very friendly.
dialogue.translation: Nzimiye. Umwanzangu yoba ari mfite ubwoba mu ntango, ariko ubwo umenye, yoba ari mwiza cyane.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's nice. My friend has a great sense of humor – he always makes me laugh.
dialogue.translation: Ni byiza. Umugenzi wanjye ufite ubwenge bw'umuntu – yoba yabaye yabaye.

scenario: Talking about education and learning
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Bikoreshwa kugirango ubone ubumenyi cyangwa ubushakashatsi.
Ikintu kigaragaza uburyo bwo kugenzura cyangwa ubwoko.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need to study more for my English course, but I don't have much time.
dialogue.translation: Nshaka kwiga cyane ku korere y’Icyongereza, ariko nta nshuro nto nifite.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Why don't you practice with me every evening? We can learn together.
dialogue.translation: Kuki ntugutangira namwe buri ihejuru? Dufite ubushakashatsi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, but I have a question: do you think our teacher will help us if we don't understand something?
dialogue.translation: Ni ubwenge, ariko nifite ibibazo: Ese wibuka ko mwalimu yacu azadutwara igihe twibura kintu?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course, our teacher always answers every question with a clear example.
dialogue.translation: Yego, mwalimu yacu yubika buri kibazo n’ubugerageza.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I hope I can remember all the new words we learn.
dialogue.translation: Nshaka kubyibuka amashusho yose yifashaye tubyiwe.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: If you practice daily, you will see that you remember more easily.
dialogue.translation: Iyo utangira buri munsi, uzabona ko ubyibuka cyane.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. Let's start today, and I'll be a better student!
dialogue.translation: Woba uri cyo cyiza. Tubanze uyu munsi, nkazaba umugakore mwiza!

key_phrases.phrase: Why don't you practice with me?

scenario: Discussing a problem and offering solutions
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Naho yari mu burere bwa bivugwe, birahindwa hano kandi bifite ikimenyetso: 'agree on' (kubishimira ku).

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We have a big problem with the schedule for next week.
dialogue.translation: Dufite ibibazo byinshi ku buryo bwa kuri iyumvire ry'icyumweru.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I know it's hard, but maybe we can find a solution together.
dialogue.translation: Nzi ko bigomeke, ariko byari kuva twebwe tubona ubburundu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'd like to offer my idea: we could move the meeting to Friday.
dialogue.translation: Nshaka kugira icyo: twebwe tubona ubburundu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds easy to do, but will everyone agree on the new time?
dialogue.translation: Bihutaze kugira, ariko ese buri wese yubaka ku gihe kishya?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Let's ask them first, and then we can decide what to do.
dialogue.translation: Tubarure maze hanyuma twebwe tugushishikana.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Good plan. Let's do that and solve this problem today.
dialogue.translation: Igikorwa nini. Tugire kandi gufata ibibazo.

scenario: Comparing two options for a trip
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Bifashishwa ku gihe, si ku kugeza.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I can't decide which option to choose for our trip: the bus or the train.
dialogue.translation: Ntabwo nashobora kumenya hitamo iki cyo kugena mu safiri yacu: busi cyangwa treni.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Well, the bus is cheaper than the train, but it's slower.
dialogue.translation: Busa, busi ni murongo kurushaho treni, ariko ni rambye.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but the train costs more, and we need to arrive quickly.
dialogue.translation: Yego, ariko treni gushushanya cyinshi, kandi dukeneye kugera kirekire.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Also, the train is safer, especially at night.
dialogue.translation: Naho treni iruhije, neza cyane ku ijoro.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: But the train is more expensive, and we can bring more luggage on the bus.
dialogue.translation: Ahubwo treni bigaragara, kandi tugashobora kujya na ibintu byinshi ku busi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's true. So maybe we should take the bus and spend less money.
dialogue.translation: Ni byiza. Bityo, byari kuva byiza tutegereje busi kandi dukoresheje amafaranga ageze.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, let's go with the bus. We can save money and still have fun.
dialogue.translation: Busa, turinde busi. Tugashobora kwihanganira amafaranga kandi turonoke.

scenario: Talking about social media habits
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ikorwa nka verb (gushyira) no nka ishito (ishusho).
Kinjiwe mu irangamimerere ry'ibiri mu mafunguro: gushiraho ibintu.
Gutegura umuntu mu irangamimerere ry'ibiri mu mafunguro.
Feed ni urutonde rw'ibintu usanga wabonye.
Isura yawe mu irangamimerere ry'ibiri mu mafunguro.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How often do you usually post on social media?
dialogue.translation: Ushyira hehe niba ushaka gushyira mu mafunguro y'ibiri mu mafunguro?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I try to share something every day, but sometimes I just scroll through my feed without posting.
dialogue.translation: Nshaka gushiraho ikintu komeza komeza, ariko nta nshaka gutegura mu rutonde rw'ibintu nashobora kugira nta nshaka gushyira.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you follow many people?
dialogue.translation: Utegura abantu benshi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, but I mostly follow friends and family. I don't like getting too many likes or comments, so I keep my profile private.
dialogue.translation: Yee, ariko ntegura abahinzi n'abagenzi. Nta nshaka gutegura intere nshya cyangwa ibituma, kugira two ntegura isura yange binyabiziga.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's smart. I have a public profile because I want more people to see my posts.
dialogue.translation: Ni byiza. Nfite isura ya umumwe kubera ko nshaka abantu benshi kubona ibintu nashyira.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I understand. But being online all the time can be exhausting, so I limit my time.
dialogue.translation: Nzimiye. Ariko kuba mu kaganza komeza komeza bishobora gutuma ububura, kugira two nshaka gutegura igihe nashaka.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. Maybe I should do that too.
dialogue.translation: Woba uri cyo. Nshobora no kugira two nshaka gutegura.

key_phrases.translation: gutegura mu rutonde rw'ibintu nashobora kugira

scenario: Giving a short presentation at work
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Mu bihe by'igishushanyo, 'main point' ni igitekerezo gikuru.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, let's start. My presentation will include three main parts.
dialogue.translation: Ego, gucike. Igishushanyo cyanjye kigiye kugira igice gikuru gisatu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds good. What is your first point?
dialogue.translation: Bitewe neza. Ni ikihe ni igitekerezo cyawe cyambere?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The first part is about our sales results from last month.
dialogue.translation: Igice cyambere ni ibirebana n'ubushobozi bwacu bw'ubucuruzi bw'ukwezi ukaze.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: And what will you cover next?
dialogue.translation: N'ikihe uzagira inyuma?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Next, I'll talk about our main challenges during that period.
dialogue.translation: Inyuma, nzababajije iby'ibikorwa byacu by'ingenzi mu gihe cyo kwinjira.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Will you also mention the new marketing strategy?
dialogue.translation: Ese no kandi uzabimenyesha ubumenyi mubiri mu bumenyi?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, that's an important point, and I'll end with our goals for this month.
dialogue.translation: Yego, ni igitekerezo by'ingenzi, kandi nzatera n'ibitekerezo byacu by'ukwezi.

scenario: Discussing a sport or hobby you follow
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Mu kino kiri kugura igisporto cyangwa ikipi, si ku mitwe y'ibiri ku isosiyeri.
Bifashishwa kugirango hagaragaze ibintu bibiri bidacarikana.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you follow any sport? I'm really into football.
dialogue.translation: Wigura igisporto? Ndagukunda igitabo cy'umupira.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I watch basketball. My favorite team is the Lakers, although they don't win every match.
dialogue.translation: Yego, ndebona umupira wa basketball. Ikipi njakunda cyane ni Lakers, no kandi ntibashyinga buri mukino.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: They played against the Celtics last night, right? Who scored the most points?
dialogue.translation: Bapfuye muri Celtics kare, ese? Ni nde yatangiye amabara menshi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yeah, but we lost. Their best player had an amazing game.
dialogue.translation: Yego, ariko twihanganye. Umukinozi wabo w'indashyikirwa yakoze umukino mukomeye.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a shame. Do you think they have a chance in the playoffs this season?
dialogue.translation: Ni ibishoboka. Wemera ko baba mfite ikibazo mu matora yo ku munsi w'umukino?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe, but it's hard. Although they have good players, they need to improve their defense.
dialogue.translation: Byari, ariko ni bikomeye. No kandi baba mfite abakinozi bashya, bakenera kugabanya ubwoko bwabo.
